regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow eligible rotation (5 of 22 themes) led by Semiconductors and AI Compute & Optics, with Semiconductors in a trend regime and not crowded. However, the absolute-trend gate has historically failed to reduce drawdown in this market (gate_helps=false), and the track record is near chance (9 calls, 44% hit rate), warranting extreme humility.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: The detector shows Semiconductors as the top-ranked eligible theme, with an intact trend (hurst_tag='trend'), moderate breadth (0.364), and no crowding. In the absence of a dominant one-narrative panic or a confirmed handoff, we tentatively lean overweight, judging that the trend may persist. This is a low-conviction, fallible judgement because the absolute-trend discipline offers no historical drawdown control in this market.
theses.dissent: China A-shares mean-revert; the trend gate has not held here, making trend-following unanchored. Semiconductors could abruptly roll over if macro attention shifts (e.g., geopolitics or policy shift).

falsifier.text: Semiconductors loses eligibility OR becomes crowded (crowding_z > 2) OR its relative score vs AI Compute & Optics drops below 0.5 within 20 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
